_meta.purpose: Temporary, dated exceptions for mutating domain routes that do not yet flow through a governed entry point (BaseEngineController -> EngineExecutionService).
rules: Every entry MUST carry: route, controller, method, capability_key, reason, risk, owner, removal_milestone, expires.
An entry whose expires date has passed FAILS the build. Extending it requires an explicit, reviewed diff.
A mutating domain route with no entry FAILS the build.
An entry whose route/controller/method no longer matches the live route table is STALE and FAILS the build.
These are exceptions, not architecture. Do not add to this file to make a new violation pass.
_meta.not_grandfathered: CustomerDomainController::setAutoRenew() calls the registrar connector directly from a controller. It is listed here as a VIOLATION with an owner and a removal date. It is not accepted architecture.

route_exceptions.reason: Creates a commercial order and freezes server-side pricing. Predates the governed pipeline. Re-routing it through TaskService is Phase 4 and must not change payment or pricing behaviour.
Creates a Stripe payment session. Payment logic is explicitly out of scope for Phase 0.
Dispatches a read-only registrar refresh job directly instead of via TaskService. Low risk: no mutation at the provider.
VIOLATION - calls the registrar connector DIRECTLY from a controller, bypassing both the governed pipeline and the engine layer. Recorded as debt, explicitly NOT grandfathered.
Operator retry of a failed registration. Re-dispatches the job directly. Safe today because the adapter re-checks ownership before spending, but ungoverned.
Operator-triggered read-only refresh. Ungoverned but non-mutating at the provider.
Bulk read-only refresh, capped at 200 domains. Ungoverned but non-mutating at the provider.

direct_provider_access.reason: Controller resolves NamecheapRegistrarConnector directly. A controller must never reach a provider; this belongs behind the engine layer.
Admin health surface calls the connector directly for a read-only healthCheck. Read-only, but still a controller-to-provider dependency.
Admin inventory calls the connector directly for a read-only listDomains. Read-only controller-to-provider dependency.
